title: Finance Manager
description:
Roles and Responsibilities 
 Manage financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting for the institution.
 Oversee cash flow management, working capital optimization, and fund management to ensure efficient use of resources.
 Ensure compliance with tax laws and regulations by managing indirect taxes (GST) and direct taxes (income tax).
 Conduct audits to identify areas of improvement in finance control processes.
 Analyze financial data to provide insights on profitability, liquidity, and risk exposure. 
 Presentation of data to Group level and management

Key Skills: Finance Control,Budgeting,Taxation,Financial Management,Fund Management,Accounting,Financial Planning,Working Capital Management
